programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: On Peter his new job it is not running as hoped. But Camille also has a hard time when she sees an objectionable photo of Vince and Caro. programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: All students fall under the spell of Giovanni's conspiracy theories. He claims that Marsmannetjes want to take over the power on earth. Pedro uses this lie and claims that Soekie is a Marsmannetje. Soekie flees the Brollers who want to lock her up. Pedro now sees his chance to take over the role of chairman of Soekie. But his plan turns against him. The Brollers reason because Pedro wants to take over the power, he is also a Marsmannetje. / Alle leerlingen raken in de ban van de complottheorieën van Giovanni het Lichtwezen. Hij beweert dat marsmannetjes de macht willen overnemen op aarde. Pedro gebruikt deze leugen en beweert dat Soekie een marsmannetje is. Soekie vlucht voor de Brollers die haar willen opsluiten. Pedro ziet nu zijn kans om de rol van voorzitter van Soekie over te nemen. Maar zijn plan keert tegen hem. De Brollers redeneren omdat Pedro de macht wil overnemen, hij ook een marsmannetje is.

programme.title: Bernie / Bernie
programme.desc: Funny animation series about the brilliant inventor Bernie who is lost on the bottom of the ocean. With his clumsy and crazy new neighbors, a return to the island is not easy! / Grappige animatiereeks over de geniale uitvinder Bernie die verdwaald is op de bodem van de oceaan. Met zijn onhandige en maffe nieuwe buren wordt een terugkeer naar het eiland alvast niet makkelijk!

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: When the annual Hopper Survival cannot continue because there is a storm weather, the hoppers decide to do the survival at home. Even though they stay at home, Jackie wants to make the survival as real as possible. This way the electricity is turned off and they are not allowed to take food or drink from the fridge. The other hoppers do their best to go with Jackie's enthusiasm until they get hungry. Arno, Geert and Daria don't know what to do. They want to give up, but they don't want to disappoint Jackie. / Wanneer de jaarlijkse Hopper Survival niet kan doorgaan omdat er stormweer is, beslissen de Hoppers om de survival thuis te doen. Ook al blijven ze thuis, toch wil Jackie de survival zo echt mogelijk maken. Zo wordt de elektriciteit uitgezet en mogen ze geen eten of drinken uit de frigo nemen. De andere Hoppers doen hun best om mee te gaan in het enthousiasme van Jackie, tot ze honger krijgen. Arno, Geert en Daria weten niet wat ze moeten doen. Ze willen opgeven, maar ze willen Jackie niet teleurstellen.

programme.title: Animal doctor 24/7 / Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Labrador Java is operated on. The surgeons are very curious about what they will find in his stomach. Five foals were born in the reproduction and obstetrics department last night. So today the students have five placentas to investigate. Moritz is a German donkey with a heart problem. His heart rhythm is so slow that Moritz is constantly fainting. Professor Van Loon wants to place a pacemaker at the donkey. / Labrador Java wordt geopereerd. De chirurgen zijn erg benieuwd naar wat ze in zijn maag allemaal zullen aantreffen. Bij de afdeling Voortplanting en Verloskunde zijn afgelopen nacht vijf veulens geboren. De studenten hebben vandaag dus vijf placentas om te onderzoeken. Moritz is een Duitse ezel met een hartprobleem. Zijn hartritme is zo traag dat Moritz voortdurend flauwvalt. Professor Van Loon wil bij de ezel een pacemaker plaatsen.

programme.title: Flikken Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: A student from the theater school in Maastricht is found dead in the Maas in the morning. Together with year -backed, he played a piece in which he had the leading role. The director is a well -known, up -and -coming talent that does not hesitate to drive his actors to the extreme with drugs if necessary. Has an experiment become fatal to the boy? Marion and Romeo resuscitate a man who appears to be in possession of a CPR-Mij-Niet-Medal. Fleur has a hard time in prison. She is threatened by women who have arrested Wolfs and Eva. / Een student van de toneelschool in Maastricht wordt s ochtends dood aangetroffen in de Maas. Hij speelde samen met jaargenoten een stuk waarin hij de hoofdrol had. De regisseur is een bekend, aanstormend talent dat niet schroomt om zijn acteurs desnoods met drugs tot het uiterste te drijven. Is een experiment de jongen noodlottig geworden? Marion en Romeo reanimeren een man die in bezit blijkt van een reanimeer-mij-niet-penning. Fleur heeft het zwaar te verduren in de gevangenis. Ze wordt bedreigd door vrouwen die Wolfs en Eva gearresteerd hebben.

programme.title: Other people's business / Andermans zaken
programme.desc: Hans is the happy manager and driving force behind a small music store in Tienen. And just like so many specialty shops, Hans also has to compete at the unbeatable prices of the large online stores. Hans sees his profit margins disappear like snow in the sun and does not know how to turn the tide. Kamal turns Hans his entire store and is fully focusing on what web shops cannot offer: experience and service. / Hans is de graaggeziene uitbater en bezieler van een kleine muziekwinkel in Tienen. En net zoals zoveel speciaalzaken, moet ook Hans opboksen tegen de onklopbare prijzen van de grote onlinewinkels. Hans ziet dan ook zijn winstmarges verdwijnen als sneeuw voor de zon en weet niet hoe het tij te keren. Kamal gooit Hans zijn hele winkel overhoop en zet volop in op wat webshops niet kunnen aanbieden: beleving en service.

programme.title: Taking care of Mama / Zorgen voor mama
programme.desc: Kristel is on the road for the fourth year in a row with coach Joost. They are introduced to Wendy and David in Rieme. Their family lives in poverty and misery, is in collective debt scheme and does not get out of the pit. In Bruges, Kristel meets Amber: 18 years and for months roof and homeless. She sleeps on squares, benches, in the bicycle shed or as a sofasurfer with friends. She has no address, no income and no work. A vicious circle. Fatih wants toy to disgrace that tangle and to give Amber shelter a first step. Deborah is the new family coach of caring for Mama. She is an experience expert and social worker. She goes with Kristel to Kessel-Lo to support young single Mama Annelie. For Kristel the start of a special process because Annelie is the daughter of Karina, a mom from the first series. The generation poverty has struck hard within the family. / Kristel is voor het vierde jaar op rij op pad met coach Joost. Ze maken in Rieme kennis met Wendy en David. Hun gezin leeft in armoede en ellende, zit in collectieve schuldenregeling en raakt maar niet uit de put. In Brugge ontmoet Kristel Amber: 18 jaar en al maanden dak- en thuisloos. Ze slaapt op pleinen, bankjes, in de fietsenstalling of als sofasurfer bij vrienden. Ze heeft geen adres, geen inkomen en geen werk. Een vicieuze cirkel. Fatih wil dat kluwen ontwarren en Amber onderdak bezorgen, een eerste stap. Deborah is de nieuwe gezinscoach van Zorgen voor mama. Ze is ervaringsdeskundige en sociaal werker. Ze trekt met Kristel naar Kessel-Lo om jonge alleenstaande mama Annelie te ondersteunen. Voor Kristel de start van een bijzonder traject want Annelie is de dochter van Karina, een mama uit de eerste reeks. De generatiearmoede heeft hard toegeslagen binnen het gezin.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Black gold / Crno zlato
programme.desc: On the Arab peninsula, during the 1930s, two Emir were clashed. The winner of Nesib, Emir Hobeike, appointed peacetime conditions to his rival Amar, Sultan Salmah. They agreed that none has the right of ownership of the country called a yellow belt. As a pledge to respect the agreement, Nesib adopts two Amar's sons, Saleh and Auda. Twelve years later, fighting Saleh wants to escape the gold cage and return to the Father. Auda is hollowed in books and longing for acquiring knowledge. One day, a American woman from Texas comes visiting Nesib. He informs him that his country is full of oil and promises his fortune that he can't even imagine. Nesib imagines unprecedented possibilities ... The kingdom with roads, schools and hospitals, funded with black gold lying under dry sand. Still, there's a problem. Precious sites are in the yellow belt. The struggle for the rule over the yellow belt is followed, also a struggle for two kingdoms and control over the future. Roles: Tahar Rahim, Antonio Bandreas, Mark Strong, Freida Pinto Director: Jean-Jacques Annaud / Na arapskom poluostrvu, tokom 1930-ih godina, sukobila su se dvojica emira. Pobjednik Nesib, emir Hobeike, postavio je mirnodopske uslove svom suparniku Amaru, sultanu Salmaha. Složili su se da nijedan nema pravo vlasništva nad zemljom zvanom Žuti pojas. Kao zalog da će poštovati dogovor, Nesib usvaja dvojicu Amarovih sinova, Saleha i Audu. Dvanaest godina poslije, borbeni Saleh želi pobjeći iz zlatnog kaveza i vratiti se ocu. Auda je udubljen u knjige i žudi za sticanjem znanja. Jednog dana, u posjetu Nesibu dolazi Amerikanac iz Teksasa. Obavještava ga da je njegova zemlja puna nafte i obećava mu bogatstvo kakvo ne može ni zamisliti. Nesib zamišlja neviđene mogućnosti... kraljevstvo sa cestama, školama i bolnicama, finansirane crnim zlatom koje leži ispod suhog pijeska. Ipak, postoji problem. Dragocjena nalazišta su u Žutom pojasu. Slijedi borba za vladavinu nad Žutim pojasom, ujedno i borba za dva kraljevstva i kontrolom nad budućnosti. Uloge: Tahar Rahim, Antonio Bandreas, Mark Strong, Freida Pinto Režija: Jean-Jacques Annaud

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E07, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E07, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti

Ona je jedna od najvažnijih i najistaknutijih zvijezda naše kulinarske scene, gastronomski virtuoz, Ana Ugarković. Njezina kulinarska emisija bila je najgledaniji televizijski projekt, a sudeći po potražnji, izdavač njezinih kuharica nije stigao otisnuti dovoljan broj knjiga. David i Ana osmišljavaju recepte za istarsku uličnu hranu. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eat on the road - (E03, Education Program, Croatia, 2025) The Gastronomic tour of David jump moves south, on Korčula. He visits Mark Turkovic, top chef, which worked in numerous restaurants with two and three Michelin stars, and today he runs his restaurant in which he cooks exclusively on live heat. Marko and David will talk about traditional foods, but prepare them according to the principles of street food. In this episode, they are looking for recipes for Korcula Street food. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo ... / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti - (E03, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Gastronomska turneja Davida Skoke kreće se prema jugu, na Korčulu. Ondje posjećuje Marka Turkovića, vrhunskoga chefa koji je radio u brojnim restoranima s dvije i tri Michelinove zvjezdice, a danas vodi svoj restoran u kojemu kuha isključivo na živoj vatri. Marko i David razgovarat će o tradicionalnim namirnicama, ali ih i pripremati po principima ulične hrane. U ovoj epizodi traže recepte za korčulansku uličnu hranu. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S01, E131, feature series, Portugal, 2024) telenovela talks about the life of a beautiful, brave and unbridled 22 -year -old girl Cacau who lives on a property where her parents are Portuguese, Joaquim and Filomena. They are hosts and people of the trust of the rich boss of Justin, a vase of Pereire, also a Portuguese, who is old and ill, and follows the business from Portugal. The best friends of Cacau are Pitty and Guto who help her make the idea that Brazil tasted the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works at the chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia where he loves surf. She is gifted with chocolate manufacturer, and her biggest dream is to get an international degree in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that this is unattainable because her family does not need money for that very expensive course. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S01, E131, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E17, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble property of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E17, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: TRUTH AND LIES - (E04, Educational Program, England, 2022) History of humanity is a history of truth and lies. Since ancient times until today, people have used lies to achieve economic, political and personal goals. This battle is run by pencil, keyboard and camera, but also weapons, torture and terror. And continues to relate countless victims. Because, who knows how to use the latest technologies most often can also gain interpretative sovereignty over what the truth is. The six -part documentary series shows that lies have been written history from an international perspective. Through various themes, it illuminates the role of the media in a merciless struggle for the truth. Truth and fabrication are nowhere as close as in religion. Secular interests are carried out under the guise of faith. In the war, lies justify bloodshed and conceal their own motives. Conspiracy theories are used for the outrage of the enemy and the creation of a grandmother. Money plays a special role because it often decides which truth will overcome. When the lies of powerful float to the light of day, scandals are created that not only stir up society, but can also become an incentive for social changes. But there will always be influential, powerful people who shape public opinions and who try to spread their own truth with all means ... / Truth and Lies - (E04, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Povijest čovječanstva povijest je i borbe istine i laži. Od davnina sve do danas ljudi su se služili lažima kako bi postigli ekonomske, političke i osobne ciljeve. Ta se bitka vodi olovkom, tipkovnicom i kamerom, ali i oružjem, mučenjem i terorom. I nastavlja odnositi bezbrojne žrtve. Jer, onaj tko zna kako se najvještije koristiti najnovijim tehnologijama, može steći i interpretativni suverenitet nad onim što istina jest. Šestodijelna dokumentarna serija prikazuje kako se lažima pisala povijest iz međunarodne perspektive. Kroz različite teme osvjetljava ulogu medija u bespoštednoj borbi za istinu. Istina i izmišljotina nigdje nisu tako bliske kao u religiji. Svjetovni se interesi provode pod krinkom vjere. U ratu se lažima opravdava krvoproliće i prikrivaju vlastiti motivi. Teorije urote rabe se za ocrnjivanje neprijatelja i stvaranje babaroge. Novac ima posebnu ulogu jer često odlučuje koja će istina prevladati. Kada laži moćnih isplivaju na svjetlo dana, nastaju skandali koji ne samo da uzburkaju društvo, već mogu postati i poticaj za društvene promjene. No uvijek će biti utjecajnih, moćnih ljudi koji oblikuju javna mišljenja i koji pokušavaju širiti vlastitu istinu svim sredstvima...

programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) We were last in Ludbreg at a time when Batthyany Castle, the most important monument in the city, was just one of many neglected and - which in this case was particularly important - empty historical assemblies. Specifically, artwork was evacuated here from war -ended or occupied parts of Croatia. Today, we were greeted by a small town aware of its history, which, like the thermal complex, the rest of the ancient iovia, is systematically explored. Likewise, the renovated Batthyany castle received a new purpose and tenants. It houses the Ludbreg Restoration Center, part of the Croatian Restoration Institute from Zagreb, where sculptures, paintings, textiles will be renewed to continue to decorate churches, museums and other public or private spaces. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) U Ludbregu smo posljednji put bili u doba kad je dvorac Batthyany, najvažniji spomenik u gradu, bio samo jedan od mnogih zapuštenih i - što je u ovom slučaju bilo osobito važno - praznih povijesnih sklopova. Naime, ovamo su se evakuirale umjetnine iz ratom ugroženih ili okupiranih dijelova Hrvatske. Danas, dočekao nas je gradić itekako svjestan svoje povijesti koja se, poput termalnog kompleksa, ostatka antičke Iovije, sustavno istražuje. Isto tako, obnovljeni dvorac Batthyany dobio je novu namjenu i stanare. U njemu je smješten Restauratorski centar Ludbreg, dio Restauratorskog zavoda Hrvatske iz Zagreba, gdje će se skulpture, slike, tekstil obnoviti da bi i dalje ukrašavali crkve, muzeje i druge javne ili privatne prostore. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E08, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to the horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E08, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E18, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E18, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program ... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica
programme.desc: The Worst Witch - (S01, E03, Children's Program, England, 2017) Mildred Hubble lives with his mother and leads a somewhat simple and quite common life. Until one day he experiences an unexpected visit from a witch named Maud Spellbody. She introduces her to the magic world. Since that day, Mildred is nothing the same for Mildred, and after joining the Cackle Witness School, he tries to improve his knowledge and skills. R.: Brian Grant Ul.: Clare Higgins (Miss Cackle), Raquel Cassidy (Miss Hardbroo), Bella Ramsey (Mildred Hubble), Meibh Campbell (Maud Spellbody), Jenny Richardson (Ethel Hallow) ... / The Worst Witch - (S01, E03, dječji program, Engleska, 2017) Mildred Hubble živi s majkom i vodi pomalo jednostavan i prilično uobičajen život. Sve dok jednog dana ne doživi neočekivani posjet od vještice po imenu Maud Spellbody. Ona je upoznaje sa svijetom čaranja. Od tog dana za Mildred ništa nije isto, a nakon pridruživanja školi za vještice Cackle, trudi se poboljšati svoje znanje i vještine. R.: Brian Grant Ul.: Clare Higgins (Miss Cackle), Raquel Cassidy (Miss Hardbroom), Bella Ramsey (Mildred Hubble), Meibh Campbell (Maud Spellbody), Jenny Richardson (Ethel Hallow)...

programme.title: Postcards from Malaysia / Razglednice iz Malezije
programme.desc: Postcards from Malaysia - (E02, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2003) in Malaysia, the country of extremely rich and diverse animal and plant worlds, and in the almost two -minute capital of Kuala Lumpur you can visit pieces of earthly paradise, orchid gardens and hibiscus, and the largest pre -covered bird in the world in which many species live out of cages. What do the metropolis of the metropolis look like, and how do those in the third largest world of Borneo world are? What life is the inhabitants of traditional Bornean villages on the water? Together with our team, take a peek at the Jungle to meet some of the last copies of Orangutan or literally step the bottom of the South Chinese Sea ... R .: Milka Barisic ... / Razglednice iz Malezije - (E02, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2003) U Maleziji, zemlji iznimno bogatog i raznolikog životinjskog i biljnog svijeta, i u gotovo dvomilijunskom glavnom gradu Kuala Lumpuru možete posjetiti komadiće zemaljskoga raja, vrtove orhideja i hibiskusa, te najveći natkriveni park ptica na svijetu u kojem mnoge vrste slobodno žive izvan kaveza. Kako izgledaju tržnice velegrada, a kako one na trećem po veličini svjetskom otoku Borneu? Kakav život vode stanovnici tradicionalnih borneanskih sela na vodi? Zajedno s našom ekipom zavirite u džunglu u susret s nekim od posljednjih primjeraka orangutana ili doslovno zakoračite dnom Južnog kineskog mora... R.: Milka Barišić...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: The Croatian Podmorje - (S05, E07, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) The last episode of "Croatian Submarine" is dedicated to the activities behind the camera that are invisible to the viewer. And as the beautiful staff of the above sea and submarine promote in front of the camera, there is a lot of effort behind it, but also of interesting and tense moments. Even before the camera is taken and dives, it is interesting to see how the series is created: preparation, going to locations, diving, recording, unexpected challenges, problems and many anecdotes. In parallel to this you will see what the recordings were made in these situations. The collage of the most beautiful, the most challenging, most dramatic, most demanding staff for recording and diving were created in the most difficult conditions and the most indirect places. Most of them are not available to ordinary divers, and many are marked by various legends. This episode is dedicated to the most beautiful diving locations, the most interesting living beings that are always fascinated. It is also dedicated to those curious beings that hold the camera and forget the fear in the desire to bring such shots. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S05, E07, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Zadnja epizoda "Hrvatskog podmorja" posvećena je aktivnostima iza kamere koje su gledatelju nevidljive. I dok pred kamerom promiču predivni kadrovi nadmorja i podmorja, iza nje je puno truda, ali i zanimljivih i napetih trenutaka. Pa čak i prije nego se uzme kamera i zaroni, zanimljivo je vidjeti kako nastaje serijal: priprema, odlazak na lokacije, ronjenje, snimanje, neočekivani izazovi, problemi i mnoštvo anegdota. Paralelno s tim vidjete ćete koje su snimke nastale u tim situacijama. Kolaž najljepših, najizazovnijih, najdramatičnijih, najzahtjevnijih kadrova za snimanje i ronjenje nastajali su u najtežim uvjetima i najnedostupnijim mjestima. Većina njih nisu dostupna običnim roniocima, a mnoga su obilježena raznim legendama. Ova epizoda posvećena je najljepšim ronilačkim lokacijama, najzanimljivijim živim bićima koja uvijek nanovo fasciniraju. Posvećena je i onim radoznalim bićima koja drže kameru i zaboravljaju strah u želji da donesu ovakve snimke. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: Teacher / Nastavnik
programme.desc: Les Grands Esprits - (Film, France, 2017) at a cocktail in Paris, François Foucault, an unmarried professor, a beautiful woman she wants to seduce to say that the best teachers should be sent to schools in a poor suburbs to get rid of the crisis in national education. They also arrange a meeting, and François, a professor of literature in the renowned Paris High School Henri IV, is surprised that his interlocutor works at the Ministry of Education, and that his joke, understood literally, has interpreted the superior civil servants as a request for "experimental" transfer. François has nowhere to go: one year he has to teach unmotivated teens at school in evil voice. In one of them, he recognizes the potential and decides to help him succeed. R .: Olivier Ayache-Vidal Ul.: Denis Podlydès (François Foucault), Abdoulaye Diallo (Seydou), Pauline Huruguen (Chloe), Alexis Moncorge (Gaspard), Tabono Tandia (Maya) ... / Les grands esprits - (film, Francuska, 2017) Na koktelu u Parizu, François Foucault, neoženjeni profesor, lijepoj ženi koju želi zavesti kaže kako bi najbolje nastavnike trebalo poslati u škole u siromašnim predgrađima ne bi li se riješila kriza u nacionalnom obrazovanju. Dogovaraju susret i François, profesor književnosti u renomiranoj pariškoj gimnaziji Henri IV, s čuđenjem doznaje da njegova sugovornica radi u Ministarstvu obrazovanja, te da su njegovu šalu, shvaćenu doslovno, nadređeni državni službenici interpretirali kao zahtjev za "eksperimentalni" premještaj. François nema kamo: godinu dana mora podučavati nemotivirane tinejdžere u školi na zlu glasu. U jednom od njih prepoznaje potencijal i odlučuje mu pomoći da uspije. R.: Olivier Ayache-Vidal Ul.: Denis Podalydès (François Foucault), Abdoulaye Diallo (Seydou), Pauline Huruguen (Chloe), Alexis Moncorge (Gaspard), Tabono Tandia (Maya)...

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: ART - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Art - Your Culture Address! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 8.10pm, we bring you the best from the art world and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music ... / ART - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Art - vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) "His supporting hand - curating curator: Davor Matičević" is an exhibition that reveals to us who was a charismatic curator dedicated to art, who fought for her life's right to vote and a dignified place in society. Next year, he will be 30 years since the premature death of curator and former director of the Contemporary Art Gallery in Zagreb, and it is the museum in which he has woven himself, the Museum of Contemporary Art, he wants to remind you that in our cultural area Davor Matičević left an indelible mark. In the studio, we talk to Leil Topic and Zeljko Luketic, and Dubravka Rakoci, Tihomir Milovac and Zeljko Kipke also participate in the show. R.: Vesna Lukovic Žarno ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2023) "Njegova podržavajuća ruka - kuriranje kustosa: Davor Matičević" izložba je koja nam otkriva tko je bio karizmatični kustos posvećen umjetnosti, koji se cijeli radni vijek borio za njezino pravo glasa i dostojanstveno mjesto u društvu. Sljedeće godine bit će 30 godina od prerane smrti kustosa i bivšeg ravnatelja Galerije suvremene umjetnosti u Zagrebu, a upravo muzej u koji je utkao sebe, Muzej suvremene umjetnosti, želi podsjetiti da je u našem kulturnom prostoru Davor Matičević ostavio neizbrisiv trag. U studiju razgovaramo s Leilom Topić i Željkom Luketićem, a u emisiji sudjeluju i Dubravka Rakoci, Tihomir Milovac i Željko Kipke. R.: Vesna Luković Žarn...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Our today's guest Dragan Velikic even received twice the NIN award for Best Novel, for the "Russian window" and "elderly". He is the recipient of the Milos Crnjanski Award, Mesa Selimovic, Kocic's Pero and numerous other awards. "Via Pula", the first novel by Dragan Velikać was published in 1988 in Serbian because, as the author says, he did not think about the content of Pula and the language of Belgrade; That was not excluded at the time. Velikic wanted to return Via Pula to her mother's speech, so in the Croatian edition of Roman Paola Orlic, she adapted the text and realized the writer's wish. The novel "Astrana" was published in 1991 in the famous hit Library Zlatko Crnkovic, but then remained confused with a whirlwind of war, so the new edition, three decades later, was the opportunity for the first and to others for a new reading during another, today's current war. Thus, the transformation books in time and the transformation itself have transformed ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Naš današnji gost Dragan Velikić čak je dvaput dobio NIN-ovu nagradu za najbolji roman, za "Ruski prozor" i "Islednika". Dobitnik je nagrade Miloš Crnjanski, Meša Selimović, Kočićevo pero i brojnih drugih nagrada. "Via Pula", prvi roman Dragana Velikića objavljen je 1988. na srpskom jeziku jer, kako kaže autor, nije razmišljao o tome da je sadržaj pulski a jezik beogradski; to se tada nije isključivalo. Velikić je želio "Via Pulu" vratiti materinskom govoru pa je u hrvatskom izdanju romana Paola Orlić adaptirala tekst i ostvarila piščevu želju. Roman "Astragan" objavljen je 1991. u slavnoj Hit biblioteci Zlatka Crnkovića ali tada je ostao zameten vihorom rata pa je novo izdanje, tri desetljeća poslije, jednima prilika za prvo a drugima za novo čitanje u vremenu jednog drugog, danas aktualnog rata. Tako su se knjige koje se bave transformacijom u vremenu i same pomalo transformirale...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: The world of classics - (music. A show, Croatia, 2024) The artists who have been talked about in recent years have suddenly arrived under the concert podium reflectors, so we have not arrived with them with their beginnings. Such an occasion appeared in the reflexive atmosphere of their joint recitali, organized by the Croatian Association of Music Artists, in the cycle music artists Zagreb, on March 26, 2024. Daria realized only the recreational playing music during her education, playing the violin, and then spontaneously converted to solo singing. Vedran, on the other hand, tried to resist the influence of a musical family (father pianist and professor piano, sister Jazz composer), eventually finding his path as a pianist of a sophisticated classic repertoire. Darija is on the threshold of his worldwide success today, a permanent member of the Zagreb Opera, but is increasingly visiting foreign opera productions. Vedran extended his postgraduate at the prestigious London's Royal Academy of Music. In this show, with the fragments of Solo songs of Rahmaninova, Kunac, Poulenac, Copland and Gershwin, they reveal hidden hopes, desires, secrets, victims, but also the price of their success ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Umjetnici o kojima se proteklih godina mnogo govori, naglo su stigli pod reflektore koncertnih podija, tako da nismo stigli s njima popričati njihovim počecima. Takva se prigoda javila u refleksivnom ozračju njihova zajedničkog recitala koji u organizaciji Hrvatske udruge glazbenih umjetnika, u ciklusu Glazbeni umjetnici Zagrebu, 26. ožujka 2024. ostvaruju sopranistica Darija Auguštan i pijanist Vedran Janjanin. Darija je glazbu tijekom školovanja shvaćala tek rekreativno, svirala je violinu, a onda spontano prešla na solopjevanje. Vedran se s druge strane pokušao opirati utjecaju glazbeničke obitelji (otac pijanist i profesor klavira, sestra jazz skladateljica), da bi na kraju pronašao svoj put kao pijanist sofisticiranog klasičnog repertoara. Darija je danas na pragu svojega svjetskog uspjeha, stalna je članica Zagrebačke opere, ali sve češće gostuje u inozemnim opernim produkcijama. Vedran je produžio svoj poslijediplomski na prestižnoj londonskoj Kraljevskoj akademiji za glazbu. U ovoj emisiji, uz ulomke solopjesama Rahmanjinova, Kunca, Poulenca, Coplanda i Gershwina, otkrivaju skrivene nade, želje, tajne, žrtve, ali i cijenu njihova uspjeha...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2023) In Dear Diklić, we are fortunate to watch and listen to a person who not only lived through a significant part of the contemporary history of our popular music, but in different ways embodies it. The time is Slager, Opatija, Dancers, Big Bands and Jazz. Diklić stepped into this seductive world as a saxophonist and singer, next time who, as an undisputed star, has been awarded by Ivo Robic. Diklić was one of our pioneers baritone saxophones and played in numerous orchestras and compositions at the time. In the meantime, the saxophone has fallen into the background in front of the singing microphone does not mean that he has left jazz aside. He still forms an important part of the tradition that Diklić invokes in various forms, as, after all, the jazz grew music that he celebrated. When he paid tribute to his friend and colleague Ivo Robic in the Zagreb factory in mid -March, his performance was not only a dedication to the golden age of our popular music, but also the proof that new generations like to capture something from his nostalgic glare. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2023) U Dragi Dikliću imamo sreću gledati i slušati osobu koja ne samo da je proživjela značajan dio suvremene povijesti naše popularne muzike, nego ju na različite načine utjelovljuje. Doba je to šlagera, Opatije, plesnjaka, big bendova i jazza. Diklić u taj zavodljivi svijet zakoračuje kao saksofonist i pjevač, slijedeći put koji je kao neprikosnovena zvijezda utabao Ivo Robić. Diklić je bio jedan od naših pionira bariton saksofona te je svirao u brojnim tadašnjim orkestrima i sastavima. To što je u međuvremenu saksofon pao u drugi plan pred pjevačkim mikrofonom ne znači da je ostavio jazz po strani. On još uvijek tvori važan dio tradicije na koju se Diklić poziva u raznim oblicima, kao što je, uostalom, iz jazza izrasla glazba kojom se proslavio. Kada je sredinom ožujka u zagrebačkoj Tvornici odao koncertnu počast svom prijatelju i kolegi Ivi Robiću, njegov nastup nije bio samo posveta zlatnom dobu naše popularne glazbe nego i dokaz da nove generacije vole uhvatiti nešto od njegovog nostalgičnog odbljeska. R.: Melanija Pović Jagarinec...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E05, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. We will find out how art affects the great builders of our time, from Santiago Calatrave to Sir David Adjae. We will get acquainted with a variety of projects, from the Batters power plant, through the Vanda Museum in Dundee, Distiliya in Speyside, the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, the remodeled Museum of Design in London, to Vessel, which is not a house, but a magnificent staircase that will soon become a new symbol of Manhattan. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E05, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Serija predstavlja neke od najslavnijih arhitekata na svijetu. Saznat ćemo kako umjetnost utječe na velike graditelje našeg doba, od Santiaga Calatrave do Sir Davida Adjayea. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It is time for jazz-(music. Show, Croatia) brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerats and festivals, reporting reviews of current events on the Croatian jazz-Cena ... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni...

programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2001) Toso Dabac, one of the largest Croatian photographers of the 20th century, has a refined sensibility in the recording of the city's atmosphere, quickly photographic thinking and spontaneity and determination in the framing of the photo. He is most appreciated and remembered for the cycle of "People from the Street" in which he records the crisis of Zagreb's thirties, but also by other, "hedonist" paintings, in which the city always pulses, the vibrancy of the street, passers -by and inscriptions on stores. Despite the thematically colorful oeuvre, often dictated by orders, he is primarily an urban photographer, even more precisely - photographer of Zagreb. He died on May 9, 1970. And behind him remained a photographic story about Zagreb, people, crazy politics and joy of living ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2001) Tošo Dabac, jedan od najvećih hrvatskih fotografa 20. stoljeća, posjeduje rafinirani senzibilitet u bilježenju ugođaja grada, brzo fotografsko razmišljanje te spontanost i odlučnost u kadriranju fotografije. Najviše je cijenjen i zapamćen po ciklusu "Ljudi s ulice" u kojem bilježi krizu zagrebačkih tridesetih, ali i po ostalim, "hedonističkim" slikama, u kojima uvijek pulsira grad, živost ulice, prolaznici i natpisi na trgovinama. Unatoč tematski šarolikom opusu, često diktiranom narudžbama, on je prije svega urbani fotograf, čak točnije - fotograf Zagreba. Umro je 9. svibnja 1970. a iza njega je ostala fotografska priča o Zagrebu, ljudima, ludosti politike i radosti življenja...

programme.title: The reader club / Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: The reader club - (Art Magazine, Croatia, 2025) in the study show "Club of Readers" every week will be discussed one title that is currently read in Croatia. The reader club on Prisavlje, with eminent critics and theorists, will include passionate readers from various cities and various areas of life, retirees, students, high school students, bloggers, professors, athletes, entrepreneurs, artists, libraries and all those who still believe that the book is the best thing in life. Become a part of our club! ... / Klub čitatelja - (umjetnički magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) U studijskoj emisiji "Klub čitatelja" svakog će se tjedna razgovarati o jednom naslovu koji se trenutačno čita u Hrvatskoj. Čitateljski klub na Prisavlju, uz eminentne kritičare i teoretičare, uključivat će strastvene čitatelje iz raznih gradova i raznih područja života, umirovljenike, studente, srednjoškolce, blogere, profesore, sportaše, poduzetnike, umjetnike, bibliotekare i sve one koji još uvijek vjeruju da je knjiga najbolja stvar u životu. Postanite i vi dio našeg Kluba!...

U pet festivalskih dana stisnulo se 30 programa na kojima će pisci iz 15-ak zemalja otkriti čitateljima sve što ih zanima o njihovim najnovijim knjigama. Dio druženja s piscima i atmosfere 13. programme.title: 16. Summer School of Film "Josip Krunić" in Gunji - Chronicles / 16. Ljetna škola filma "Josip Krunić" u Gunji - kronike
programme.desc: 16th Summer School "Josip Krunić" in Gunja - Chronicle - (E02, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) 16. Summer School "Josip Krunić" is held from August 30 to September 4, 2025. At the Zvjezdangrad Forest Camp in Spačva. FREE workshops of feature, documentary and animated film and cyanotypes are involved in about 20 young people from 16 to 25 years. The organizer is the multimedia center of Studio Creative Ideas Gunja (MMC skig), and the school ends with a solemn screening of works of all students. programme.title: Labyrinth lies / Labirint laži
programme.desc: Im Labyrinth des Schweigens - (Drama, Germany, 2014) Germany 1958 Renewal, Economic Miracle. Johann Radmann (Alexander Fehling) was recently appointed a public prosecutor. Like all beginners, he must be satisfied with boring traffic offenses. Radmann is interested in journalist Thomas Gnielka (Andre Szymanski) causes confusion in the courtroom. Gnielka's friend recognized a teacher who was once a guard in Auschwitz. But no one wants to judge him. Although his superiors are opposed to this, Radmann begins to explore the case. Suddenly he finds himself in a network of repression and denial, but also idealization. At that time, "Auschwitz" was a word that some had never heard, and many wanted to forget her as soon as possible. Only Chief Prosecutor Fritz Bauer (Gert Voss) encourages Radmann's curiosity. He has long wanted to make people aware of the crimes they have committed in Auschwitz, but there is no legal tools to firm. After Johann Radmann and Thomas Gnielka find documents leading directly to the perpetrator, Bauer immediately realizes how important they are and the official investigation entrusts Radmann. The young prosecutor is completely dedicated to this new assignment and is determined to find out what happened. He examines the witnesses, searches the documents, provides evidence, and allows the case to be captured so much that he becomes blind to everything else around him, even to Marlene Wondrak (Friederike Becht), which he fell in love with. Radmann crosses the boundaries, quarrels with friends, colleagues and allies, and goes deeper into the maze of lies and guilt in search of truth. But what will eventually discover will forever change the whole country. R.: Giulio Ricciarelli Ul.: Alexander Fehling (Johann Radmann), Andre Szymanski (Thomas Gnielka), Friederike Becht (Marlene Wondrak), Johannes Krisch (Simon Kirsch), Johann von Bulow (Staatsanwalt Haller) ... / Im Labyrinth des Schweigens - (drama, Njemačka, 2014) Njemačka 1958. Obnova, gospodarsko čudo. Johann Radmann (Alexander Fehling) nedavno je imenovan javnim tužiteljem. Kao i svi početnici, mora se zadovoljiti dosadnim prometnim prekršajima. Radmann se zainteresira nakon što novinar Thomas Gnielka (Andre Szymanski) izazove pomutnju u sudnici. Gnielkin prijatelj prepoznao je učitelja koji je nekoć bio čuvar u Auschwitzu. No nitko mu ne želi suditi. Iako se njegov nadređeni protivi tomu, Radmann počinje istraživati taj slučaj. Odjednom se nađe u mreži represije i poricanja, ali i idealiziranja. U to je vrijeme "Auschwitz" bila riječ koju neki nikada nisu ni čuli, a mnogi su je htjeli što prije zaboraviti. Samo glavni tužitelj Fritz Bauer (Gert Voss) potiče Radmannovu znatiželju. On odavno želi osvijestiti ljude o zločinima koje su počinili u Auschwitzu, no nema pravnih alata da podigne optužnice. Nakon što Johann Radmann i Thomas Gnielka pronađu dokumente koji vode izravno do počinitelja, Bauer odmah shvati koliko su važni te službeno istragu povjeri Radmannu. Mladi se tužitelj posve posveti tom novom zadatku te je odlučan u namjeri da sazna što se zapravo dogodilo. Ispituje svjedoke, pretražuje dokumente, osigurava dokaze i dopušta da ga slučaj toliko zaokupi da postaje slijep na sve ostalo oko sebe, čak i na Marlene Wondrak (Friederike Becht) u koju se ludo zaljubio. Radmann prelazi granice, svađa se s prijateljima, kolegama i saveznicima te sve dublje zalazi u labirint laži i krivnje u potrazi za istinom. Ali ono što će na kraju otkriti zauvijek će promijeniti cijelu zemlju. R.: Giulio Ricciarelli Ul.: Alexander Fehling (Johann Radmann), Andre Szymanski (Thomas Gnielka), Friederike Becht (Marlene Wondrak), Johannes Krisch (Simon Kirsch), Johann von Bulow (Staatsanwalt Haller)...

The film is attended by architects Attilio Krizmanic and Branko Bratkovic, photographer Hassan Abdelghani and researcher Josip Vretenar. These are all lovers of the Austro -Hungarian history of the City of Pula, who in their own way complete the colorful picture of today with their artistic and scientific work. The alternative is also synonymous with Pula, so subcultural individuals appear in the film who are organizing music festivals at Austro -Hungarian fortresses. The famous history seems to inspire the people of Pula to be active participants in their society and thus preserve the tradition of decay and oblivion. R.: Nikolina Baric ... / Austrijski štih i hrvatski san - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2014) Dokumentarni film govori o gradu Puli i njezinom značaju za vrijeme Austro-Ugarske te o došljacima koji su u posljednjih sto godina od Pule stvorili liberalan multietnički grad. U filmu sudjeluju arhitekti Attilio Krizmanić i Branko Bratković, fotograf Hassan Abdelghani i istraživač Josip Vretenar. Sve su to ljubitelji austrougarske povijesti grada Pule, koji na svoj način upotpunjuju šaroliku sliku današnjice svojim umjetničkim i znanstvenim radom. Alternativa je također sinonim za Pulu, pa se u filmu pojavljuju i subkulturni pojedinci koji na austrougarskim tvrđavama priređuju glazbene festivale. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2023) In Dear Diklić, we are fortunate to watch and listen to a person who not only lived through a significant part of the contemporary history of our popular music, but in different ways embodies it. The time is Slager, Opatija, Dancers, Big Bands and Jazz. Diklić stepped into this seductive world as a saxophonist and singer, next time who, as an undisputed star, has been awarded by Ivo Robic. Diklić was one of our pioneers baritone saxophones and played in numerous orchestras and compositions at the time. In the meantime, the saxophone has fallen into the background in front of the singing microphone does not mean that he has left jazz aside. He still forms an important part of the tradition that Diklić invokes in various forms, as, after all, the jazz grew music that he celebrated. When he paid tribute to his friend and colleague Ivo Robic in the Zagreb factory in mid -March, his performance was not only a dedication to the golden age of our popular music, but also the proof that new generations like to capture something from his nostalgic glare. R.: Melanija Povic Jagarinec ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2023) U Dragi Dikliću imamo sreću gledati i slušati osobu koja ne samo da je proživjela značajan dio suvremene povijesti naše popularne muzike, nego ju na različite načine utjelovljuje. Doba je to šlagera, Opatije, plesnjaka, big bendova i jazza. Diklić u taj zavodljivi svijet zakoračuje kao saksofonist i pjevač, slijedeći put koji je kao neprikosnovena zvijezda utabao Ivo Robić. Diklić je bio jedan od naših pionira bariton saksofona te je svirao u brojnim tadašnjim orkestrima i sastavima. To što je u međuvremenu saksofon pao u drugi plan pred pjevačkim mikrofonom ne znači da je ostavio jazz po strani. On još uvijek tvori važan dio tradicije na koju se Diklić poziva u raznim oblicima, kao što je, uostalom, iz jazza izrasla glazba kojom se proslavio. Kada je sredinom ožujka u zagrebačkoj Tvornici odao koncertnu počast svom prijatelju i kolegi Ivi Robiću, njegov nastup nije bio samo posveta zlatnom dobu naše popularne glazbe nego i dokaz da nove generacije vole uhvatiti nešto od njegovog nostalgičnog odbljeska. programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Our today's guest Dragan Velikic even received twice the NIN award for Best Novel, for the "Russian window" and "elderly". He is the recipient of the Milos Crnjanski Award, Mesa Selimovic, Kocic's Pero and numerous other awards. "Via Pula", the first novel by Dragan Velikać was published in 1988 in Serbian because, as the author says, he did not think about the content of Pula and the language of Belgrade; That was not excluded at the time. Velikic wanted to return Via Pula to her mother's speech, so in the Croatian edition of Roman Paola Orlic, she adapted the text and realized the writer's wish. The novel "Astrana" was published in 1991 in the famous hit Library Zlatko Crnkovic, but then remained confused with a whirlwind of war, so the new edition, three decades later, was the opportunity for the first and to others for a new reading during another, today's current war. Thus, the transformation books in time and the transformation itself have transformed ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Naš današnji gost Dragan Velikić čak je dvaput dobio NIN-ovu nagradu za najbolji roman, za "Ruski prozor" i "Islednika". Dobitnik je nagrade Miloš Crnjanski, Meša Selimović, Kočićevo pero i brojnih drugih nagrada. "Via Pula", prvi roman Dragana Velikića objavljen je 1988. na srpskom jeziku jer, kako kaže autor, nije razmišljao o tome da je sadržaj pulski a jezik beogradski; to se tada nije isključivalo. Velikić je želio "Via Pulu" vratiti materinskom govoru pa je u hrvatskom izdanju romana Paola Orlić adaptirala tekst i ostvarila piščevu želju. Roman "Astragan" objavljen je 1991. u slavnoj Hit biblioteci Zlatka Crnkovića ali tada je ostao zameten vihorom rata pa je novo izdanje, tri desetljeća poslije, jednima prilika za prvo a drugima za novo čitanje u vremenu jednog drugog, danas aktualnog rata. Tako su se knjige koje se bave transformacijom u vremenu i same pomalo transformirale...

programme.title: My India / Moja Indija
programme.desc: My India - (E01, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2002) We show 6 episodes of travel series about India by director Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric (1950 - 2024). The series is investigating Haridwar and Rishikesh, a pilgrimage town of Hinduist and a center of yoga in India, located next to the clear Ganges. Many come to Rishikesh today from all over the world, seeking peace and harmony. We also take you to the province of Rajestan, to the city of Pushkar, to the Festival and the Deva Fair and Jaipur, which is popularly called "Pink City" because of the facades colored in pink. We also get to know Varanas, the most holy city in India, 2000 years old. R .: Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric ... / Moja Indija - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2002) Prikazujemo 6 epizoda putopisne serije o Indiji redateljice Ljubice Janković Lazarić (1950. - 2024.). Serija istražuje Haridwar i Rishikesh, hodočasničko mjesto hinduista i centar joge u Indiji, smješteno uz bistri Ganges. U Rishikesh danas dolaze mnogi sa svih strana svijeta tražeći mir i harmoniju. Vodimo vas i u pokrajinu Rajestan, u grad Pushkar, na festival i sajam deva te Jaipur koji se popularno naziva "Pink City" zbog fasada obojenih u ružičasto. Upoznajemo i Varanasi, najsvetiji grad u Indiji, star 2000 godina. R.: Ljubica Janković Lazarić...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: The Croatian Podmorje - (S06, E01, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) The story of color emergence can be started every morning by sunrise. In addition to warmth, it is the strongest source of light, the light that we enter into the world of color. On the mainland, we learned to live with blue sky, green forests, gray cliffs, flowers of all possible colors, and our sea depths were always dark, inaccessible, threatening. Only when we started bringing artificial lighting to this dark -stainful world, did we begin to discover his amazing color. And we started learning about the sea properties of the sunlight and discover the amazing game and the struggle of two primordial elements - water and fire. In this fight, live creations were born, an unimaginable living world of submarine full of colors. And that color that is not on land, in combinations and patterns that are unthinkable in the air. Corals, gorgonia, snails, jellyfish, crustaceans, cephalopods, fish, algae doomed to forever blue have covered themselves with a variety of colors. And without artificial lighting, they do not see each other in the dark of depth at all, so the story of the colors of the living Adriatic and their purpose is even more surprising. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E01, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Priču o nastanku boja možemo započeti svakog jutra izlaskom Sunca. Osim topline ono je najjači izvor svjetlosti, svjetlosti kojom ulazimo u svijet boja. Na kopnu smo naučili živjeti s plavim nebom, zelenim šumama, sivim liticama, cvijećem svih mogućih boja, a morske su nam dubine uvijek bile tamne, nepristupačne, prijeteće. Tek kada smo počeli donositi umjetnu rasvjetu u ovaj tamnomodri svijet, počeli smo otkrivati njegove začudne kolorite. A počeli smo i učiti o morskim svojstvima Sunčeve svjetlosti i otkrivati začudnu igru i borbu dva praiskonska elementa - vode i vatre. U toj borbi rođene su žive kreacije, nezamisliv živi svijet podmorja pun boja. I to boja kakvih nema na kopnu, u kombinacijama i šarama kakve su nezamislive na zraku. Koralji, gorgonije, puževi, meduze, rakovi, glavonošci, ribe, alge osuđene na vječno plavetnilo prekrile su se najrazličitijim bojama. A one se bez umjetne rasvjete uopće ne vide u tami dubina, pa nam je priča o bojama živog Jadrana i njihovoj svrsi još začudnija. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: A collector of sounds / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sound collector - (E01, feature series, Croatia) collectors of sounds early wakes up Mirta's snoring. At first he just felt the vibration, but after putting on the hearing an apparatus, her snoring becomes very loud! He decides to embark on early -morning collecting sounds of other sleeping lives that may also snore. He leaves Mirta's breakfast and soon shoots a hedgehog under the leaves and a few rabbits sleeping in their hole. At home, Mirta woke up and eats breakfast in sweetness. She hears her enemy, a fly, as she buzzes around her head, so he tries to drive her away and make a mess in the kitchen. The sound collector is addressed somewhere where he knows he will find a loud snoring - in wildlife park! He shoots the Berber monkey naps in his dwelling and lions as she is drowsy - the perfect snoring to end his journey. She returns and finds a house in complete mess - the fly left the house, but Mirta destroyed her! They seem to be waiting for them a little cleaning. However, Mirta sleeps firmly on the couch and snore. The sound collector excludes the headphones and clings to the Mirta and soon both snore. And yet he really woke up early! ... / Skupljač zvukova - (E01, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Skupljača zvukova rano probudi Mirtino hrkanje. Isprva samo osjeti vibracije, ali nakon što stavi slušni aparat, njezino hrkanje postaje jako glasno! Odlučuje krenuti u ranojutarnje skupljanje zvukova ostalih usnulih životnja koje možda također hrču. Ostavlja Mirti doručak te ubrzo snima usnula ježa ispod lišća i nekoliko zečeva koji spavaju u svojoj rupi. Kod kuće Mirta se probudila i jede doručak u slast. Čuje svoju neprijateljicu, Muhu, kako joj zuji oko glave, pa je pokuša otjerati i pri tome napravi nered u kuhinji. Skupljač zvukova upućuje se nekamo gdje zna da će pronaći glasno hrkanje - u park divljih životinja! Snima berberskog majmuna kako drijema u svojoj nastambi i lavove dok se pospano bude - savršeno hrkanje kojim će završiti svoje putovanje. Vraća se i zatekne kuću u potpunom neredu - Muha je napustila kuću, ali Mirta ju je uništila! Čini se da ih čeka malo pospremanja. Međutim, Mirta čvrsto spava na kauču i hrče. Skupljač zvukova isključuje slušalice i priljubljuje se uz Mirtu i ubrzo oboje hrču. Pa ipak se stvarno rano probudio!...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: The Croatian Podmorje - (S06, E01, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) The story of color emergence can be started every morning by sunrise. In addition to warmth, it is the strongest source of light, the light that we enter into the world of color. On the mainland, we learned to live with blue sky, green forests, gray cliffs, flowers of all possible colors, and our sea depths were always dark, inaccessible, threatening. Only when we started bringing artificial lighting to this dark -stainful world, did we begin to discover his amazing color. And we started learning about the sea properties of the sunlight and discover the amazing game and the struggle of two primordial elements - water and fire. In this fight, live creations were born, an unimaginable living world of submarine full of colors. And that color that is not on land, in combinations and patterns that are unthinkable in the air. Corals, gorgonia, snails, jellyfish, crustaceans, cephalopods, fish, algae doomed to forever blue have covered themselves with a variety of colors. And without artificial lighting, they do not see each other in the dark of depth at all, so the story of the colors of the living Adriatic and their purpose is even more surprising. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E01, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Priču o nastanku boja možemo započeti svakog jutra izlaskom Sunca. Osim topline ono je najjači izvor svjetlosti, svjetlosti kojom ulazimo u svijet boja. Na kopnu smo naučili živjeti s plavim nebom, zelenim šumama, sivim liticama, cvijećem svih mogućih boja, a morske su nam dubine uvijek bile tamne, nepristupačne, prijeteće. Tek kada smo počeli donositi umjetnu rasvjetu u ovaj tamnomodri svijet, počeli smo otkrivati njegove začudne kolorite. A počeli smo i učiti o morskim svojstvima Sunčeve svjetlosti i otkrivati začudnu igru i borbu dva praiskonska elementa - vode i vatre. U toj borbi rođene su žive kreacije, nezamisliv živi svijet podmorja pun boja. I to boja kakvih nema na kopnu, u kombinacijama i šarama kakve su nezamislive na zraku. Koralji, gorgonije, puževi, meduze, rakovi, glavonošci, ribe, alge osuđene na vječno plavetnilo prekrile su se najrazličitijim bojama. A one se bez umjetne rasvjete uopće ne vide u tami dubina, pa nam je priča o bojama živog Jadrana i njihovoj svrsi još začudnija. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) thanks to our Gosce today, we could read many works of American literature in Croatian who wrote classics such as William Faulkner and Mark Twain. Famous English novel Emma Jane Austen has already experienced three editions in three publishing houses in her translation. She is the recipient of the Lifetime Achievement Award for the Society of Croatian Literary Translators and the Greatest Translated Acknowledgment in us, the "ISO Velikanović" award for life. There are many reasons to talk to Balen-heidl's faith, and the direct cause is the translation of the novel by Professor Edward Lewis Wallant, one of the first American novels about a man to survive the Holocaust, sold in more than 500,000 copies immediately after publishing in 1961. We went to Rijeka before Wartburg. The title is associated with the legendary Eastern-German Wartburg car, but in Žmirić's novel, he is only a trigger for memories of the years of growing up and maturing in the shadow of the dominant father, the mildest to say ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Zahvaljujući našoj današnjoj gošći, na hrvatskom smo mogli čitati mnoga djela američke književnosti koja su pisali klasici poput Williama Faulknera i Marka Twaina. Glasoviti engleski roman Emma Jane Austen u njezinom prijevodu doživio je već tri izdanja u tri nakladničke kuće. Dobitnica je nagrade za životno djelo Društva hrvatskih književnih prevodilaca i najvećeg prevodilačkog priznanja u nas, nagrade "Iso Velikanović" za životno djelo. Mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Vjerom Balen-Heidl, a direktan povod prijevod je romana Zalagaoničar Edwarda Lewisa Wallanta, jedan od prvih američkih romana o čovjeku koji je preživio Holokaust, prodan u više od 500.000 primjeraka odmah po objavljivanju 1961. Prije toga idemo u Rijeku, u posjet piscu Zoranu Žmiriću kojemu je upravo izišao novi roman, Hotel Wartburg. Naslov asocira na legendarni istočno-njemački automobil Wartburg, ali on je u Žmirićevom romanu tek okidač za uspomene na godine odrastanja i sazrijevanja u sjeni dominantnog oca, najblaže rečeno...
